name: Lawrence County, Pennsylvania (United States)
description: White field charged with a yellow-edged green map of the county bearing a disc with stylised fields, water and an ear of wheat, over the words LAWRENCE COUNTY, PENNSYLVANIA in black.
history: Lawrence County is a county in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. The flag was adopted in 1982 (the winner of a 1982 flag design contest, designed by Rosemary Ann Marino, a commercial artist from New Castle, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: map of the county edged in yellow, with a disc of fields, water and wheat
